messages.text: Hi, thanks for contacting Bluewave Internet. How can I help?
My internet stopped working an hour ago. I already restarted the router twice.
Thanks for trying that. There's an outage in your area. Our team expects service to return by 11 P.M. tonight.

options: C. Moved to a different area
questions.explanation: Omar writes, "I already restarted the router twice."

questions.stem: What does the agent imply about Omar's problem?
options: A. It is not limited to his home.
B. It is caused by his router.
C. It will last for several days.
D. It can be fixed by restarting again.
questions.explanation: Rita explains, "There's an outage in your area," meaning other customers nearby are also affected.
